name: tempergraph-monitor
description: Claude Mod showing progress of tempergraph runs: band, alerts, run view, drill-down and cost; actions fill the prompt

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Runs of this repository, or of every state root on this machine

fleet_sink.title: Fleet sink
fleet_sink.description: A sink name from the engine config for the fleet tab; empty for none

open_pane.title: Open the pane
open_pane.description: auto opens it where the layout has a sidebar; never leaves it to /tg

alerts_finished.title: Notify when a run finishes
alerts_finished.description: A native notification for exit 0, besides the toast

alerts_fleet.title: Notify for runs on other machines
alerts_fleet.description: A run waiting over 30 min on another machine

show_tool_inputs.title: Show tool inputs
show_tool_inputs.description: Off hides every tool input summary in the pane

show_log_tails.title: Show log tails
show_log_tails.description: Off hides the Log tab and check output tails

model_tool.title: Model tool
model_tool.description: off registers no tool; interactive is not built yet

engine_path.title: Engine path
engine_path.description: Path to the tempergraph shim; empty to find it on PATH
